game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: OrphanTwin
quote: The story in this game is better than basically every Star wars movie or series. Including the originals. In my opinion. Just incredible. The game is still very buggy in 2023. Not sure why some of these bugs haven't been patched. That's the only reason I couldn't give it a 10. Amazing title. I really hope they don't mess this up with the sequel by inserting new age weirdo ideas.

author: OrphanTwin
quote: Imagine needing constant validation so much for your weird ideas that you have to insert it into every aspect of your life daily. I'm sure I have lots of things that lots of people don't agree with... I dont need them to. Forbidden West was already off to a bad start. Aloy is boring. She has no personality. She fights for nothing basically. She is the most ambiguous and lifeless fictional heroin to ever exist. They should make a version of this game where you can join Hades. Sign me up. Theres a reason this world was meant to fail.

author: OrphanTwin
quote: One of the greatest games ever made. The world build is insane. Just so impressed with how the story is unfolding and how everything looks. Some of these boss fights are some of the most inventive ideas I’ve ever seen.

author: OrphanTwin
quote: It’s just boring. The story is basically nothing. There is no family. Nothing to care about. Aloy is boring and uninteresting. Not to mention she sounds like she is is bored and uninterested in every conversation. Also, the leaders in the story are all dumb and make bad emotional decisions. But that’s a different story. Boring. Boring. Boring.

author: OrphanTwin
quote: Haha. Who made this? Some of the worst story telling ever made. I mean, I LOVE bad fiction but this story is ridiculously horrible. At least that made it funny before I stopped playing. Lara loved her father. He was a bad ass and Lara wanted to be just like him. There weren’t any “secrets” about her mother like this. But, we all know what you were trying to do. But I laughed when it was all conveniently behind an actual secret room with puzzles! Also, this scene just makes Lara’s mom look like a huge b. The ol “yoU’Re AwAy aLl tHe tIMe”. Yeah lady, he’s working. Looks like Lara grew up just fine and followed in his footsteps. Another hilariously overdone subversive story that didn’t work the way it was intended. It’s just too bad to see this bad fan fiction made it through. Rehire the people you replaced. Never make another tomb raider please.

author: OrphanTwin
quote: Game smashes! Will only get better. I love how many upgrade options there are. Looking forward to seeing where all of this goes.

author: OrphanTwin
quote: This is easily my favorite game I’ve ever played. I keep going back to it. It’s always there with new content WEEKLY! Always updating and changing. You can always expect it to cater to gamers. It’s still full of new things that I’ve yet to discover. There is tons of exclusive content that is time sensitive. But overall it’s the community that makes it amazing. Everyone is there to help each other get that BREAD!

author: OrphanTwin
quote: This is one of the best looking games I’ve ever seen. The mechanics are incredible. The story is great. Well done. Nothing else has come out this year that’s really worth ANYTHING. Loving this.
